description: Ready for a Power BI Dashboard that Makes People Want to Dive Deeper? Your dashboard has a story to tell, but what happens when nobody's listening? Lack of buy-in = No change. Enlighten Aquarium is a Power BI Custom Visual that offers a refreshingly different approach. Your data becomes a school of sea creatures swimming in an underwater world, where KPIs, rankings, and performance comparisons become more engaging while encouraging interaction and healthy competition. Use Cases: How Enlighten Aquarium Turns the Tide on Team Engagement Every whale, shark, and fish tells a story based on your data, creating a fun environment that encourages the behaviours and results you desire. Sales Teams: Transform dreaded weekly reviews into competitive sessions where reps compete for the biggest shark in the tank. Safety Compliance: Manufacturing plants turn safety metrics into engaging aquatic displays where team members actively monitor and improve their safety performance. Customer Support: Ticket resolution becomes an aquatic adventure where teams compete to be the fastest, biggest fish. Sustainability Goals: Organizations motivate employees as they watch their environmental "ocean" grow healthier with each green initiative. In each case, disengagement is transformed into enthusiasm, making dashboard reviews something teams look forward to. Enlighten Aquarium is Perfect for: Performance…
